decision: Materialize local AI-assisted raster editing as a specialized projection of FA3-IMGGEN-001, not as a new capability or authority.
rationale: GIMP 3.x is the primary raster authoring frontend, not a model or orchestration authority.
ComfyUI is the primary local generative workflow backend while Forge and stable-diffusion.cpp remain replaceable alternatives.
Standalone local operation and FA3-governed operation are both required.
Hardware binding must be discovered dynamically so accelerator replacement does not require GIMP-side reconfiguration.
